headline: Kyrgyzstan wants to increase guarantees on bank deposits
summary: Kyrgyz authorities are considering increasing the guaranteed reimbursement amount for bank deposits. Currently, depositors are covered in the event a financial institution goes bankrupt.
why: Deposit guarantees protect savers when banks fail and shape depositor confidence and banking-sector stability. Changes to coverage limits affect the funding costs and risk profile of local lenders.
original_headline: В Кыргызстане хотят увеличить гарантии по банковским вкладам
